feature: NOT EXISTS anti-join excludes rows whose correlated subquery matches

scenarios.name: NOT EXISTS excludes targets that have a guard edge
scenarios.inspired_by: opencypher TCK — clauses/match-where (NOT EXISTS negated pattern predicate)

scenarios.name: NOT EXISTS combined with COUNT counts only unguarded targets
scenarios.inspired_by: opencypher TCK — clauses/match-where (NOT EXISTS composed with COUNT)
scenarios.query: MATCH (s)-[:PG_LINKS]->(t) NOT EXISTS { MATCH (g)-[:PG_OPTIONAL]->(t) } RETURN s.entity_id AS source_id, COUNT(t) AS unguarded_count

scenarios.name: NOT EXISTS inner WHERE narrows the anti-join so guarded target survives
scenarios.inspired_by: opencypher TCK — clauses/match-where (NOT EXISTS subquery carrying its own correlated inner WHERE)
scenarios.query: MATCH (s)-[e:PG_LINKS]->(t) NOT EXISTS { MATCH (g:pg_node)-[:PG_OPTIONAL]->(t) WHERE g.data.severity_score > 100 }

scenarios.name: NOT EXISTS over a multi-hop inner chain that matches nothing keeps every target
scenarios.inspired_by: opencypher TCK — clauses/match-where (NOT EXISTS over a 2-hop inner pattern)
